 reunión presencial

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 CONSENT CALENDAR (1 – 15)

 1.  26-54766  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $13,000, offset by the Seventh Council District One-Time
  District Priority Funds, transferred from the Citywide Activities Department, to
  support the following:
  1. $1,000 to United Cambodian Community in support of Long Beach
  Sankranta;
  2. $10,000 to the Museum of Latin American Art in support of their 30th
  Anniversary Gala;
  3. $1,000 to Long Beach Forward in support of Long Beach LGBTQIA2S+
  Community Health Summit;
  4. $1,000 to Cambodia Town, Inc in support of the Cambodia Town Parade;
  and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $13,000, to offset transfers to the City Manager Department.

   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Office or Department:  Roberto Uranga, Vice Mayor, Seventh District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54767  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $1,400, offset by the Eighth Council District One-Time
  District Priority Funds, transferred from the Citywide Activities Department, to
  provide contributions of:
  1. $300 to the Black Employees Association of Long Beach for the annual
  Michael Betts Scholarship Program;
  2. $300 to Long Beach Pride for the 2026 Pride Festival on May 16-17, 2026;
  3. $300 to Long Beach Nonprofit Partnership for the Community Breakfast on
  May 22, 2026;
  4. $500 to Friends of Long Beach Firefighters for the 2026 St. Baldrick’s
  Foundation Cars and Clippers Fundraising Event on March 14, 2026; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $1,400, to offset a transfer to the City Manager Department.

  Office or Department:  Tunua Thrash-Ntuk, Councilwoman, Eighth District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54773  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $6,275, offset by the Sixth Council District One-Time
  District Priority Funds, transferred from the Citywide Activities Department, to
  provide contributions of:
  1. $125 to American Indian Changing Spirits, in support of their 25th
  Anniversary;
  2. $250 to the LGBTQ Center to support their 5th Annual Trans Day of
  Visibility Celebration;
  3. $200 to One in Long Beach Inc, in support of their 2026 Long Beach Gives
  Campaign;
  4. $200 to the Speak Up Empowerment Foundation Inc, in support of their
  10th annual Ms. Single Mom Empowerment Forum;
  5. $500 to CLIMB, in support of their Women’s Symposium;
  6. $2,500 to the Cambodia Town Inc in support of their Parade & Festival
  sponsorship;
  7. $2,500 to the United Cambodian Community, in support of the Long Beach
  Sankranta Festival hosted by the Cambodian American Cultural Center;
  and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $6,275, to offset transfers to the City Manager Department.

  approved, authority to pay $56,260, in compliance with the Appeals Board Order

  Office or Department:  City Attorney

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Office or Department:  City Manager

  to extend the term of the contract to March 31, 2027. (Citywide)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Human Resources

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  documents necessary to amend Contract No. 35598 with Health Advocate, of
  Omaha, NE, for providing a comprehensive and strategic suite of health resources,
  to extend the term of the contract to February 28, 2027. (Citywide)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Human Resources

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) License, at 6430 East Pacific Coast Hwy #120.
  (District 3)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Police Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Community Development Week

PUBLIC COMMENT: Obtain speaker card from the City Clerk
Opportunity to address the City Council (on non-agenda items) is given to the first 10 persons who
submit Speaker Cards to the City Clerk beginning at 15 minutes prior to the commencement of the
meeting. Each speaker is allowed three minutes to make their comments.

REGULAR AGENDA

16. 26-54768  Recommendation to authorize a seven percent (7%) merit compensation increase
  to the annual base salary of Francine Kerridge, Director of Police Oversight, at an
  amount equal to $245,093.191, effective October 4, 2025, issue a $3,000 one-time
  performance incentive to Francine Kerridge, Director of Police Oversight, and
  amend the City Salary Schedules effective October 4, 2025, October 18, 2025,
  November 15, 2025, November 29, 2025, December 27, 2025, January 24, 2026,
  and March 7, 2026 to reflect the 7% increase to the annual base salary of the
  Director of Police Oversight classification.

  Office or Department:  Rex Richardson, Mayor

  Page 5 of 10
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 7, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

17. 26-54774  Recommendation to request City Manager to take formal steps to establish Long
  Beach as a major destination and participant in the Pier-to-Pier Coastal Ferry
  Program, working with all appropriate departments including Parks, Recreation and
  Marine and Public Works, and engaging with regional partners including LA Metro
  and the Board of Supervisors to leverage the Belmont Pier, the Queen Mary, the
  City’s downtown waterfront, and other coastal assets to support the development
  of innovative regional transportation systems to better connect Long Beach to
  cities across the region in preparation for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic
  Games.

  Office or Department:  Rex Richardson, Mayor

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

18. 26-54777  Recommendation to request City Manager to work with relevant departments to
  begin the process in amending and updating the Long Beach Municipal Code,
  Chapter 5.81 “Tobacco Retail Permit” to include required distances, or “buffer
  zones,” between smoke shops, tobacco retailers, and/or smoking lounges and
  youth-oriented areas (i.e. schools, daycare centers, playgrounds, libraries, parks,
  recreation facilities, youth programming events that occur at parks, etc.) and elder
  care facilities (nursing homes, convalescent homes, etc.), and report back to
  council within 120 days.

  Office or Department:  Megan Kerr, Councilwoman, Fifth District; Tunua
  Thrash-Ntuk, Councilwoman, Eighth District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

19. 26-54718  Recommendation to adopt resolution approving an exception to the 180-day
  waiting period for Public Agencies pursuant to Government Code 7522.56 and
  21224, to hire Julie Bedard for a limited duration to work in the Police Department.
  (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Human Resources

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

20. 26-54719  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute an
  agreement with Evolution Risk, for healthcare specific stop-loss reinsurance
  coverage with a $500,000, deductible level, at an estimated cost of $3,193,000, for
  a twelve-month period retroactively effective January 1, 2026; and execute any
  subsequent amendments necessary to maintain current benefit levels and remain
  in compliance with state and federal laws. (Citywide)

  Page 6 of 10
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 7, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Office or Department:  Human Resources

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

21. 26-54720  Recommendation to adopt Specifications No. R-7261 and award a contract to All
  American Asphalt, of Corona, CA, for as-needed local street improvements, in
  amount not to exceed $60,000,000, for a period of two years, with the option to
  renew for three additional one-year periods, at the discretion of the City Manager;
  and, authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all documents necessary to
  enter into contracts, including any necessary amendments. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Public Works

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

ORDINANCE

22. 26-54597  Recommendation to declare ordinance amending Long Beach Municipal Code
  (LBMC) Section 5.92.030, Section 8.68.160, Section 8.68.170 and adding Division
  XIII to Chapter 5.92 (Adult Use Cannabis Business and Activities); all relating to
  the regulation of cannabis special events, read and adopted as read. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  City Manager; City Attorney

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

23. 26-54600  Recommendation to declare ordinance amending Title 5 of the Long Beach
  Municipal Code by amending and restating Chapter 5.80, all relating to the
  implementation of a permanent Taxicab Program, read and adopted as read.
  (Citywide)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Financial Management

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
